translations.web: Immediately coming up from the water, he saw the heavens parting, and the Spirit descending on him like a dove.
translations.bsb: As soon as Jesus came up out of the water, He saw the heavens breaking open and the Spirit descending on Him like a dove.
translations.kjv: And straightway coming up out of the water, he saw the heavens opened, and the Spirit like a dove descending upon him:
